SETUP
1. Tap “Install for Android Auto” and confirm in the system installer; reopen OgAuto when it closes. The status line should show Play installer ✓.
2. If it is still missing, tap the Android Auto version 10 times, enable unknown sources in developer settings and check Customize launcher.
3. Enable touch control. On Android 13+, if blocked: App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.
4. Grant display over other apps: the phone is locked to landscape while sharing and the car screen is filled.
5. Start sharing; the system dialog shares the entire screen. Open Mirror in the car. Streams in apps like VYPN play in the car too. If the picture stalls, tap ↻ in the car.
The driver must not use this while driving. Support: onurguner.bjk@gmail.com

Streams play directly on the car screen without screen mirroring, so the freeze does not happen on this path. In VYPN or another IPTV app choose OgAuto as “External player”, or share the stream link to OgAuto. You can also add an M3U playlist. DRM services such as Netflix are not supported.
